additional_info.subject: ID0440282-DC/Si-DC/BE-[MP / PD 170001238]  software issue CRM:02682000234
additional_info.body:
Hi Laurent! Good afternoon.
Thanks for the reply. I send the config files in attachment.
Since the charger is v7.0.5 and the only config files we have are from v6.0.3, we need to flash the CFAST back to v6.0.3 in order to avoid further problems.
If you need support let me know, when you are performing the LiveLinux restore config you need to follow these new rules:
Turn off charger
Insert CFAST and USB
Turn ON charger
Press ESC with external keyboard (USB)
Press F1 to select boot menu
Select X60, X61, X62 depending on which port you inserted the USB
Let the restore config work - it will restart on its own
Press ESC again and F1
Select CFAST
When you see the Hello screen you can remove the USB.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0440282-DC/Si-DC/BE-[MP / PD 170001238]  software issue CRM:02682000234
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning.
I apologise for the delay, I will give you everything you need to flash the CFAST and restore the ID of the charger.
To which email can I send the FW version? As soon as you provide it to me, I will send it via Email since it is too big to send via ticketing system.
The steps are:
Buy a CFAST reader, here are several examples:
https://www.amazon.com/cfast-card-reader/s?k=cfast+card+reader
If you have one skip this step above.
Install Rufus -
https://rufus.ie/en/
Extract the FW version once (the file will be big)
Use Rufus to flash the CFAST with the FW version.
Use USB with LiveLinux to restore the configuration of the charger
Do you have this USB stick already? I already sent the config files to Laurent previously so I think you have it
Turn off charger
Insert CFAST and USB
Turn ON charger
Press ESC with external keyboard (USB)
Press F1 to select boot men
Select X60, X61, X62 depending on which port you inserted the USB
Let the restore config work - it will restart on its own
Press ESC again and F1
Select CFAST
When you see the Hello screen you can remove the USB.
Let me know to which email I should send the FW.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0440282-DC/Si-DC/BE-[MP / PD 170001238]  software issue CRM:02682000234
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe,
Thanks for the fast feedback.
I will send the FW to Bob then. The instructions for the LiveLinux are the following:
Recommended USB of 32GB Transcend -
https://www.amazon.es/s?k=transcend+32gb+usb
Since we already tested this USB, but feel free to use another one, we are just not sure if it works completely well.
Format the USB stick to FAT32
Use Rufus to Flash the USB with the Livelinux.img that I will send in the email.
Now you should see in the USB
Go to Script_library and copy "Restore-config"
Paste in the Scripts_to_run and delete all the others scripts that are inside that folder (delete the copy-tar and displayport-fix).
Create a folder on the root (next to the autorun, EFI and linux) called data and insert the extracted config files there. I am sending the config files again in attachment.
After this, just follow the previous instructions.
The email with the SW has been sent.
If you need support on-site, please reach out to @HelioxPlanner.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

ID0440282-DC/Si-DC/BE-[MP / PD 170001238] software issue CRM:02682000234
Hello Chlöe, good morning.
I apologise for the delay, I will give you everything you need to flash the CFAST and restore the ID of the charger.
To which email can I send the FW version? As soon as you provide it to me, I will send it via Email since it is too big to send via ticketing system.
The steps are:
Buy a CFAST reader, here are several examples:
https://www.amazon.com/cfast-card-reader/s?k=cfast+card+reader
If you have one skip this step above.
Install Rufus -
https://rufus.ie/en/
Extract the FW version once (the file will be big)
Use Rufus to flash the CFAST with the FW version.
Use USB with LiveLinux to restore the configuration of the charger
Do you have this USB stick already? I already sent the config files to Laurent previously so I think you have it
Turn off charger
Insert CFAST and USB
Turn ON charger
Press ESC with external keyboard (USB)
Press F1 to select boot men
Select X60, X61, X62 depending on which port you inserted the USB
Let the restore config work - it will restart on its own
Press ESC again and F1
Select CFAST
When you see the Hello screen you can remove the USB.
Let me know to which email I should send the FW.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
